title: Palace Tour
text: Missing the queues allowed us to spend more time viewing the rooms in the palace. Once the guided tour was over we could walk at leisure around the gardens

title: An excellent and engaging tour
text:
An excellent well informed and interesting tour
We are so pleased we chose to go with Laura. Her English is excellent and she is friendly and engaging.
author: Bonniebobber

title: The Best Tour ever!!
text: The experience itself was phenomenal. The guide was super responsive and attentive to our needs at all times. He had an exquisite knowledge of everything he showed us during the tour. No doubt I'd count on her again another time.
author: mar_ajos_l279

title: Incredible guide!
text: Laura was incredible – she won the history and architectural design together in such an easy way to understand. Well worth  it!!
author: Maureen_F

title: Appreciating the art and architecture of the Alcázar
text: Our guide, Laura, was deeply knowledgeable, energetic and delightful. She brought the history of the Alcázar to life for us. Despite the crowds of other tourists swirling around us, we felt transported through the centuries. The Alcázar itself is breathtaking, Laura added perspective and context to the stunning decor and architecture.
author: maureenf211

title: You will need an expert guide like this
text:
There were only 3 in our group, so we had expert individual attention. 

Completely knowledgeable in the art, architecture, and history of the Alcazar. And completely fluent in English.
author: CalAlPal

title: Excellent - Art on Tour Seville
text: Our tour guide Rafa’s knowledge of the Alcázar of Seville and European history in general is outstanding. He made this tour exceptional.  Highly recommend.
author: John_P

title: Can't express more. Amazing experience.  Laura gave us tips for other places and explained more about places to explor .
text: We had a great experience with our guide Laura. She is excellent. Very knowledgeable shared the history of Madrid,  Seville and Spain. I would recommend to use this tour Guide. Better than any guided tours in seville.
author: jy0rin

title: From 10!
text: Laura is a spectacular guide, she puts a lot of passion into her work and that makes the difference. We have enjoyed it very much, we will repeat with her for future visits!!

title: It was worth it
